security_spec.violation_condition: In the FreeBSD kernel, when Smctr/Ssctr is implemented in hardware but the kernel does not execute SCTRCLR or save/restore CTR indirect CSR state (siselect+sireg1-3 for CTR entries, CTR_CYCLE_COUNTER, CCV_HW) during context switch in cpu_switch(), a process can read another process's control transfer history (source/target PCs, transfer type, elapsed cycles) via the indirect CSR interface, revealing execution traces including kernel return addresses from prior context windows.
security_spec.summary: Smctr/Ssctr CTR transfer-history FIFO is not architecturally invisible per ASID/VMID; failing to clear or save/restore CTR state (via SCTRCLR or indirect CSR access) on context switch in cpu_switch() leaks cross-process control-flow traces including kernel-space return addresses
